parameters.query:
SELECT 
  id, 
  nome, 
  whatsapp_loja, 
  config_json,
  (SELECT value FROM public.configs WHERE key = 'evolution_webhook_url' LIMIT 1) AS config_evo_webhook,
  (SELECT value FROM public.configs WHERE key = 'webhook_secret' LIMIT 1) AS config_evo_secret
FROM lojas 
WHERE id = $1 
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE lojas
SET 
  whatsapp_loja = $1,
  config_json = jsonb_set(
    COALESCE(config_json, '{}'::jsonb),
    '{dadosDaLoja,whatsapp_loja}',
    to_jsonb($1::text),
    true
  ),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $2 AND (whatsapp_loja IS NULL OR whatsapp_loja = '');
